description: This Java class implements the SudoRetrieveThingStrategy, a command handling strategy for retrieving 'thing' entities, with logic to determine accessibility, schema versioning, and response construction within a persistence framework.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingStrategy
classes.description: Final class that handles the retrieval of 'thing' entities in a sudo context, determining if the command is applicable, applying the command logic, handling unhandled cases, and managing entity tags.

methods.name: SudoRetrieveThingStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the command class type.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Determines if the command applies based on context, the target 'thing', and command details.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval logic, constructing a JSON representation of the 'thing' post retrieval and wrapping it in a result.

methods.name: determineSchemaVersion
methods.description: Selects the JSON schema version to use based on command options and the 'thing's' implemented schema.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles cases where the 'thing' is not accessible, returning an error result.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag, if any, for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag for the 'thing' if it exists.
